select tt.id,tt.template_name,tt.template_type,tt.using_unit_name,tt.contract_type,tt.create_by,tt.create_time,ta.file_name,ta.file_url,tt.attachment_id from tb_template tt left join tb_attachment ta on tt.attachment_id = ta.id

SELECT tt.id, tt.template_name, tt.template_type, tt.contract_type, tt.using_unit_name, tt.create_by, tt.create_time, max(ta.file_name) as file_name, max(ta.file_url) as file_url, tt.attachment_id FROM tb_procurement_scheme s LEFT JOIN tb_procurement_scheme_bidding b ON s.id = b.scheme_id
LEFT JOIN tb_template tt ON tt.id = b.bidding_template_id
LEFT JOIN tb_template tt ON tt.id = b.contract_template_id
left join tb_attachment ta on tt.attachment_id = ta.id
tt.template_type = #{queryVO.templateType,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and tt.template_name like concat('%',#{queryVO.templateName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and tt.contract_type = #{queryVO.contractType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and tt.del_flag = 0
and s.state = '3' GROUP BY tt.id order by tt.create_time desc
